description_en: Calls ListNotifications to retrieve a list of notifications
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-notifications --category example-string --handle-state HANDLED --offset 0 --limit 2 --begin-millis 1514736000000 --end-millis 1514736000000 --sorting-field NOTICE_MILLIS --ascending false --api-version 2018-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNotifications

parameters.help_en: The list of notification types. Set this parameter to null to skip type filtering
parameters.help_zh: 通知类型列表，传 null 则不过滤类型
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: Filters notifications by handling status. Set this parameter to null to skip status filtering
parameters.help_zh: 根据通知处理状态过滤，传 null 则不过滤处理状态
parameters.name: handle_state

parameters.help_en: The start position of the query, as a zero-based offset
parameters.help_zh: 查询的起始位置，从 0 开始的偏移
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of notifications to query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询的通知数量上限，大于等于 1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The start time for the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 时间查询，毫秒为单位的 UNIX 时间戳
parameters.name: begin_millis

parameters.help_en: The start time for the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 时间查询，毫秒为单位的 UNIX 时间戳
parameters.name: end_millis

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Valid values: NOTICE_MILLIS (sort by notification time)
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，可取值为NOTICE_MILLIS(按照通知发生时间排序)
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en: Used together with the SortingField parameter. A value of true specifies ascending order. A value of false specifies descending order
parameters.help_zh: 配合SortingField参数一起使用，true表示升序，false表示降序
parameters.name: ascending

List.description_en: The list of notifications that match the filter conditions
List.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的通知列表

GatewayOfflineInfo.description_en:
This field has a value when Category is set to GATEWAY_OFFLINE.

The gateway offline information
GatewayOfflineInfo.description_zh:
当Category为GATEWAY_OFFLINE时，该字段有值。

记录网关离线信息

OfflineMillis.description_en: The offline time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
OfflineMillis.description_zh: 离线时间，毫秒为单位的 UNIX 时间戳

HandleState.description_en: The handling status of the notification

HandledMillis.description_en: The time when the notification was handled. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
HandledMillis.description_zh: 通知处理时间，UNIX 时间戳，毫秒为单位

JoinPermissionAuthInfo.description_en:
This field has a value when Category is set to JOINPERMISSION_AUTH.

The join permission authorization information
JoinPermissionAuthInfo.description_zh:
当Category为JOINPERMISSION_AUTH时，该字段有值。

记录凭证授权信息

AcceptedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was approved, in milliseconds
AcceptedMillis.description_zh: 工单审批通过的 UNIX 时间戳 ，毫秒为单位

ApplyingMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was submitted, in milliseconds
ApplyingMillis.description_zh: 发起工单的 UNIX 时间戳，毫秒为单位

CanceledMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was canceled, in milliseconds
CanceledMillis.description_zh: 工单被取消的 UNIX 时间戳，毫秒为单位

JoinEui.description_en: The JoinEUI used by the join permission

JoinPermissionId.description_en: The unique ID of the join permission

JoinPermissionName.description_en: The name of the join permission

OwnerAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission owner who initiated the authorization
OwnerAliyunId.description_zh: 发起授权的入网凭证拥有者的阿里云账号ID

RejectedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was rejected, in milliseconds
RejectedMillis.description_zh: 工单被拒绝的 UNIX 时间戳，毫秒为单位

RenterAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission tenant
RenterAliyunId.description_zh: 入网凭证租户的阿里云账号ID

NoticeMillis.description_en: The time when the notification occurred. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
NoticeMillis.description_zh: 通知发生时间，UNIX 时间戳，毫秒为单位

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of notifications that match the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的通知总数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
